description: Integrates a pipeline supporting modeling, deployment, and orchestration stages, incl. distinguishing development and production infrastructure nodes; adopts GitLab Runner directly on edge devices as agents communicating with the GitLab server.
Implements a distributed-resources provisioning scheme using custom nodes ('SmartX Boxes'); leverages Devstack and OpenStack; secures SmartX Box connections via Access Control over SSL/TLS.
Supports multi-tenancy so different operators can independently deploy and manage services via a microservices technology.

Uses Kubernetes to manage containerized applications (API Server, Scheduler, Controller Manager, Kubelet, Kube Proxy); Kubernetes workers run on Raspberry Pi nodes; supports automated updates for low-power microcontrollers.

Java-based Application Manager and Application Repository handling developer requests for new applications/configuration descriptions; monitoring via probes (Collectd, Logstash); security via a Java Identity Module using LDAP over SSL/TLS to an external Active Directory.
